Basithami Technology, formerly trading as PD Getyeza Security Services, has been operating in the Security Installation and Technology industry for the past 20 years. The business was founded in the year 1999 by PD Getyeza. In 2020 the company changed its name from PD Getyeza Security Services to Basithami Technology following its strategic diversification and upscaling. BASITHAMI Technology is one of the preferred service providers for companies like Standard Bank Insurance and SA Home Loans, and we have been serving on their panel of suppliers for the past 15 years. Our service offerings include Assessing; Auditing; and Electronic Repairs, Maintenance and Installation. We pride ourselves for having good trade relationships with our distributors and suppliers. This enables us to meet our clients' needs with a dynamic mix of offerings and solutions. What We Do? We drive technology advancements that will deliver the new definition of Technology in Human Experience Our Values Build strong Customer Relationships Operate with Integrity and Trust Continual Self-Improvement & Personal Excellence of our Staff Where & How We’re Different! In today’s business environment, the network and applications have become both ubiquitous and indispensable, where a small technical fault can bring a business to a virtual standstill. They are primary channels for business-critical informational and transactional exchanges of all kinds. They gather information as well as dispense it, and are therefore crucial assets in any Business Continuity strategy. It is important to recognize the nature of the new posed risks and evaluate their potential impact, to determine what can be done to mitigate the effect and at what cost. Businesses today are very dependent on system availability guaranteed “uptime” to satisfy the unlimited demands for the effective use of accumulated information, uninterrupted service delivery to improve the quality of the customer and the end-user’s experience, to maximize productivity and profitability. Businesses Continuity and risk management are underpinned by choosing the right people, processes, technology and knowledge to implement a Business Continuity strategy and to bring in the required support and services that can underpin the strategy.
